blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Wednesday maintained that the Philippines is not yet inclined to rejoin the International Criminal Court (ICC), following US President Donald Trump’s call for member nations to leave the body. Trump issued the call during his speech at the United Nations General Assembly, describing the ICC as “out of control” and a “rogue institution.” READ: Palace: PH need not rejoin ICC to fight impunity “Ang panawagan po ng US ay iginagalang po natin at sa ngayon po ay ganoon pa rin po ang stance ng ating Pangulo.
